boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University at Buffalo
boards.description: Late-evening food and snack destinations with currently published hours from UB Dining or the business itself.

cards.title: Main Street Market
cards.subtitle: Goodyear Hall, South Campus
cards.notes: Head to Goodyear Hall for the 9–11 p.m. weekday service window; confirm the academic-calendar schedule before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A South Campus option with a clearly posted late-night weekday service period.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Dining lists Main Street Market’s regular weekday hours as 7 a.m.–3 p.m. and 9–11 p.m., and identifies Late Night meal exchanges.
cards.source_title: Main Street Market | UBDining
cards.access_notes: Regular hours posted by UB Dining: Monday–Friday, 9:00 p.m.–11:00 p.m. for the late service window; summer and holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: Hubies
cards.subtitle: Ellicott Food Court, North Campus
cards.notes: Use the Ellicott Food Court’s weekday 5–11 p.m. window for pizza, wings, chicken fingers, or subs; check for break-hour changes.

cards.evidence_claim: UB Dining lists Hubies in the Ellicott Food Court as open Monday–Friday from 5–11 p.m. and accepting Late Night meal exchanges on weekdays.
cards.source_title: Hubies | UBDining

cards.title: Perks
cards.subtitle: Ellicott Food Court, North Campus
cards.notes: Stop by the Ellicott Food Court counter before its 11 p.m. weekday close for coffee, tea, baked goods, bubble tea, or ice cream.
cards.short_summary: A late-open coffee and treats counter in the Ellicott Food Court.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Dining lists Perks’ regular Monday–Friday hours as 8 a.m.–11 p.m. and describes coffee, tea, baked goods, bubble tea, and ice cream.
cards.source_title: Perks | UBDining
cards.access_notes: Regular hours posted by UB Dining: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m.; summer and holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: The Cellar
cards.subtitle: Governors Complex, North Campus
cards.notes: Plan around the 9–11 p.m. weekday reopening in Governors Complex; check UB Dining’s current schedule when classes are not in session.
cards.short_summary: A Governors Complex diner with an explicitly posted late weekday window.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Dining lists The Cellar’s regular Monday–Friday hours as 8 a.m.–3 p.m. and 9–11 p.m.
cards.source_title: The Cellar | UBDining
cards.access_notes: Regular hours posted by UB Dining: Monday–Friday, 9:00 p.m.–11:00 p.m. for the late service window; summer and holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: Jim's Steakout on Main
cards.subtitle: 3094 Main St., Buffalo
cards.notes: For an off-campus option near South Campus, use the Main Street location’s posted walk-in closing time and order before the final minutes.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street restaurant whose official location page posts food-service hours into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Jim’s Steakout lists its 3094 Main St. location open until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday, with walk-in orders accepted until closing.
cards.source_title: Jim's Steakout Locations
cards.access_notes: Official posted hours for 3094 Main St.: 10:30 a.m.–2:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 a.m.–4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; online ordering can stop earlier.

cards.title: Ellicott Food Court vending
cards.subtitle: Ellicott Complex, North Campus
cards.notes: Use the listed food-court vending machines when counters are closed; bring a payment method accepted by the machine and choose from stocked items.

cards.evidence_claim: UB Dining states that UB Snackin’ vending machines are available 24 hours a day and lists Ellicott Food Court among locations with Just Baked, Fresh Food, and Health & Wellness machines.
cards.source_title: Vending & Banking | UBDining
cards.access_notes: UB Dining states that UB Snackin’ machines are available 24 hours a day and specifically lists Ellicott Food Court as a vending location.

cards.title: Lockwood Library vending
cards.subtitle: Lockwood Library, North Campus

cards.evidence_claim: UB Dining states that UB Snackin’ vending machines are available 24 hours a day and lists Lockwood Library’s second floor among North Campus vending locations.
cards.source_title: Vending & Banking | UBDining
cards.access_notes: UB Dining states that UB Snackin’ machines are available 24 hours a day and lists Lockwood’s second floor as a vending location.

cards.title: Student Union vending
cards.subtitle: Student Union, North Campus

cards.short_summary: A central campus destination with vending locations on two floors.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Dining states that UB Snackin’ vending machines are available 24 hours a day and lists the Student Union’s first and second floors among North Campus vending locations.
cards.source_title: Vending & Banking | UBDining
cards.access_notes: UB Dining states that UB Snackin’ machines are available 24 hours a day and lists the Student Union’s first and second floors as vending locations.

cards.title: Alumni Arena vending
cards.subtitle: Alumni Arena, North Campus
cards.notes: Use the basement or first-floor machines listed by UB Dining for a late purchased snack; Fresh Food machines are noted at this destination.
cards.short_summary: An arena destination with listed basement and first-floor vending, including Fresh Food machines.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Dining states that UB Snackin’ vending machines are available 24 hours a day and lists Alumni Arena’s basement and first floor, including Fresh Food machines, as vending locations.
cards.source_title: Vending & Banking | UBDining
cards.access_notes: UB Dining states that UB Snackin’ machines are available 24 hours a day and lists Alumni Arena basement and first floor as vending locations.

cards.title: Capen Hall vending
cards.subtitle: Capen Hall, North Campus
cards.notes: Use the first-floor vending location listed by UB Dining for a purchased snack or drink after evening plans; verify building access separately.
cards.short_summary: A named North Campus academic-building destination with a listed vending stop.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Dining states that UB Snackin’ vending machines are available 24 hours a day and lists Capen Hall’s first floor among North Campus vending locations.
cards.source_title: Vending & Banking | UBDining
cards.access_notes: UB Dining states that UB Snackin’ machines are available 24 hours a day and lists Capen Hall’s first floor as a vending location.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-admission activities on campus and around Buffalo, with options for art, trails, waterfront time, and public programming.

cards.entity_name: UB Art Gallery, Center for the Arts
cards.title: See a gallery show at UB Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Center for the Arts, UB North Campus
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition before heading to the Center for the Arts, then give yourselves time to look through the work and compare favorites.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission contemporary-art stop on North Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UB’s Department of Art states that admission to the UB Art Gallery is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Circulation Issues, MFA Alumni Photography Duo
cards.access_notes: The cited UB page lists public admission and advises confirming gallery hours or an appointment in advance.

cards.title: Browse UB Anderson Gallery
cards.subtitle: One Martha Jackson Place, near UB South Campus
cards.notes: Plan a self-guided look at the gallery’s exhibition spaces, and check the gallery’s current schedule before traveling to the South Campus area.
cards.short_summary: A University at Buffalo gallery visit with documented free public access.
cards.evidence_claim: University at Buffalo identifies UB Anderson Gallery as free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: UB Anderson Gallery Announces Upcoming Exhibitions by Gerald Mead
cards.access_notes: Confirm current exhibitions and hours before visiting; the cited UB release documents the gallery’s free public admission.

cards.title: Walk Tifft’s boardwalks and trails
cards.subtitle: Tifft Nature Preserve, 1200 Fuhrmann Boulevard
cards.notes: Use the preserve’s trails and boardwalks for an unhurried nature walk; bring water and stay on marked paths while watching for birds and wetland views.
cards.short_summary: A free public trail-and-boardwalk outing near the waterfront.
cards.evidence_claim: Buffalo Museum of Science states that access to Tifft Nature Preserve’s grounds, boardwalks, and trails is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Buffalo Museum of Science and Tifft Nature Preserve newsletter
cards.access_notes: Trail hours are listed as daily from dawn until dusk; groups of 10 or more require reservations.

cards.title: Take a waterfront walk at Canalside
cards.subtitle: Canalside, Buffalo waterfront
cards.notes: Meet by the water, stroll the public paths, and use the lawn or seating for conversation; skip rentals and food purchases to keep the hang free.
cards.short_summary: A year-round, no-admission Buffalo waterfront gathering place.
cards.evidence_claim: Buffalo Waterfront states that Canalside is free, open year-round, and open to the public from dawn to dusk.
cards.source_title: Buffalo Waterfront
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk; hours may be extended during special events.

cards.title: Play pickup volleyball at the Outer Harbor
cards.subtitle: Outer Harbor, Buffalo waterfront
cards.notes: Bring a ball and gather a small group for a casual game on the sand courts; rotate teams so everyone gets a turn without needing a reservation.
cards.short_summary: Public sand-court play with no fee to join.
cards.evidence_claim: Buffalo Waterfront states that volleyball at the Outer Harbor is open to the public and free to play.
cards.source_title: Outer Harbor
cards.access_notes: The waterfront is open daily from dawn to dusk; check the venue calendar for event-related changes.

cards.title: Ride the tracks at Lakeside Bike Park
cards.subtitle: Outer Harbor, Buffalo waterfront
cards.notes: Bring your own bike and choose a track that matches the group’s comfort level; helmets and a quick equipment check make the ride more relaxed.
cards.short_summary: A free public bike-park session at the Outer Harbor.
cards.evidence_claim: Buffalo Waterfront states that Lakeside Bike Park is free to the public and open from dawn to dusk.
cards.source_title: Lakeside Bike Park
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk. Bring a personal bike to avoid the optional rental cost.

cards.title: Join the Lakeside Spoke & Social ride
cards.subtitle: Outer Harbor; Tuesday evening group ride
cards.notes: Register online or at the event, arrive for the check-in, and join the hour-long slow ride around the Outer Harbor on your own bicycle.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled, all-ages social ride with no registration charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Buffalo Waterfront describes The Lakeside Spoke & Social as a free, all-ages ride and requires participants to sign up online or in person.
cards.source_title: The Lakeside Spoke & Social
cards.access_notes: Listed Tuesdays from 6–8 p.m.; participants must register and should bring their own bicycle.

cards.title: Spend the day at Music Is Art
cards.subtitle: Terminal B, Outer Harbor — September 12, 2026
cards.notes: Go for the live music, performances, dance, and visual art; plan transport home in advance and keep the day free by passing on vendor purchases.
cards.short_summary: A forthcoming public arts festival at Terminal B.
cards.evidence_claim: Buffalo Waterfront states that Music Is Art 2026 at Terminal B is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Music Is Art 2026
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for September 12, 2026, 11 a.m.–11 p.m.; food, beverages, and shops are optional purchases.

cards.entity_name: Steel Plant Museum of Western New York
cards.title: Explore the Steel Plant Museum
cards.subtitle: Heritage DiscoveRY Center, Buffalo
cards.notes: Browse the museum’s steel-industry displays at your own pace, then use a few exhibits as prompts to trade observations about Buffalo’s industrial history.
cards.short_summary: A permanently free public museum visit in Buffalo.
cards.evidence_claim: The Steel Plant Museum of Western New York states that it is always free to the public.
cards.source_title: Steel Plant Museum of Western New York
cards.access_notes: Located inside the Heritage DiscoveRY Center; check the museum directly for current visiting arrangements.

cards.entity_name: AP Gorny: Different From the Rest
cards.title: See the AP Gorny Rare Book Room exhibition
cards.subtitle: Rare Book Room, Buffalo & Erie County Public Library
cards.notes: Visit the Rare Book Room to see the exhibition, then leave time to browse the Central Library’s public spaces and discuss the books on display.
cards.short_summary: A current free exhibition in the downtown Central Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Buffalo & Erie County Public Library states that AP Gorny: Different From the Rest is free and open to the public and on view through fall 2026.
cards.source_title: Buffalo & Erie County Public Library Presents AP Gorny: Different From the Rest
cards.access_notes: At the Central Library Rare Book Room, 1 Lafayette Square; the source lists the exhibition through fall 2026.

cards.notes: Walk or ride past the park and use UB’s archive page to connect the building to the university’s off-campus research and incubator history.

cards.evidence_claim: UB’s archives identify Baird Research Park at 1576 Sweet Home Road near North Campus and describe its research-incubator history.

cards.title: Eggertsville Community Park for a loop trail

cards.notes: Use the semi-paved loop trail, benches, and bike rack for a short outdoor reset; plan around the town’s posted dawn-to-dusk park hours.

cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Amherst lists Eggertsville Community Park at 845 Sweet Home Road with a semi-paved looped trail, playground, basketball court, seating, and dawn-to-dusk hours.

cards.access_notes: Verify library hours and program availability before visiting.

cards.notes: Follow the marked nature trail or paved trailway, then pause at the lake and bench seating; this is an outdoor option with town-posted dawn-to-dusk access.
cards.short_summary: A park with lake, marked trail, and birding-trail designation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Amherst lists Walton Woods Park at 400 John James Audubon Parkway with paved and marked trailways, a lake, shore-fishing access, and a marked nature trail.
cards.source_title: Walton Woods Park — Town of Amherst
cards.access_notes: Town listing gives dawn-to-dusk hours; use marked routes and comply with posted park rules.

cards.title: Amherst State Park for creek access
cards.subtitle: Mill Street corridor — 390 Mill Street
cards.notes: Use the stonedust trail and designated creek or shore-fishing access, keeping to marked public areas and the town’s listed dawn-to-dusk schedule.
cards.short_summary: A Mill Street conservation-area stop with trail and creek access.
cards.evidence_claim: Amherst’s parks inventory lists Amherst State Park at 390 Mill Street with a stonedust trail, creek access, shore-fishing access, heritage orchard, and community garden.
cards.source_title: 2025 Parks Inventory — Town of Amherst
cards.access_notes: Town inventory lists the park as open all seasons, dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Ellicott Creek Island Park for creekside scenery
cards.subtitle: Old Niagara Falls Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Use the Town of Amherst parks inventory as a starting point, then check current local signage and access conditions before visiting this named creekside park.
cards.short_summary: A named municipal park listed on Old Niagara Falls Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Amherst’s parks inventory identifies Ellicott Creek Island Park on Old Niagara Falls Boulevard.
cards.source_title: 2025 Parks Inventory — Town of Amherst
cards.access_notes: Confirm current access and follow any posted park rules on arrival.

cards.title: North Forest Park for a town-park stop
cards.subtitle: North Forest Road corridor
cards.notes: Locate the named park from the Town of Amherst’s current parks directory, then use posted information on site to choose an appropriate daytime visit.
cards.short_summary: A municipal park destination on the North Forest Road corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Amherst includes North Forest Park in its official list of neighborhood parks.
cards.source_title: Town of Amherst Parks
cards.access_notes: Check the town directory and onsite signage for current facilities and hours.

cards.title: University Station for rail access
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — UB South Campus terminus
cards.notes: Use the current NFTA rail schedule to plan a Main Street trip between South Campus, the medical corridor, downtown, and Canalside.
cards.short_summary: The Metro Rail terminus serving UB South Campus on Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: NFTA states Metro Rail operates between DL&W Station and University Station at UB South Campus, serving destinations via Main Street.
cards.source_title: 145 Metro Rail — NFTA Metro
cards.access_notes: Consult NFTA’s current schedule and fare information before travel.

cards.title: LaSalle Station for the trail connection
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — Main Street and LaSalle Avenue
cards.notes: Use the rail stop as a mapped connection point, and pair it with the adjacent North Buffalo Rails to Trails route only when conditions suit your plan.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street rail station beside the North Buffalo trail connection.
cards.evidence_claim: NFTA identifies LaSalle Station at Main Street and LaSalle Avenue in Buffalo’s University District, adjacent to North Buffalo Rails to Trails.
cards.source_title: LaSalle & DL&W Metro Rail Stations — NFTA Metro
cards.access_notes: Check NFTA service updates and trail conditions before departure.

cards.title: Audubon Golf Course for public-course access
cards.subtitle: Maple Road corridor — 500 Maple Road
cards.notes: Review the town recreation program and course information before booking or arriving; the official inventory identifies this named public-course destination on Maple Road.
cards.short_summary: A Town of Amherst public golf-course destination on Maple Road.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Amherst recreation inventory identifies Audubon Golf Course at 500 Maple Road, and the recreation department describes public golf courses as available spring through late fall.
cards.source_title: Amherst Youth & Recreation
cards.access_notes: Golf is seasonal; verify current course operations, reservations, and fees directly before visiting.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented University at Buffalo traditions, from the first-year human logo to annual cultural celebrations.

cards.title: Become part of the Interlocking UB
cards.subtitle: Welcome Weekend and New Student Orientation
cards.notes: Join the incoming class as it assembles the human interlocking UB logo during the fall Welcome Weekend tradition.
cards.short_summary: A first-year class forms UB’s human logo together.
cards.evidence_claim: UB says thousands of incoming first-year students form the iconic human interlocking UB at the start of each fall semester; the tradition was established in 2005.
cards.source_title: Celebrating Traditions - the Interlocking UB
cards.access_notes: Presented as part of Welcome Weekend; consult current orientation programming for participation details.

cards.title: Carry True Blue into Homecoming
cards.subtitle: Fall campus celebration
cards.notes: Plan around the fall reunion weekend, when students, alumni, families and friends gather for UB spirit programming.
cards.short_summary: UB’s annual fall reunion of campus and alumni communities.
cards.evidence_claim: UB identifies Homecoming & Family Weekend as an annual tradition and dates the earliest archived mention of a UB Homecoming football game to November 6, 1924.
cards.source_title: Celebrating Traditions - Homecoming & Family Weekend
cards.access_notes: Held annually in fall; check the current Homecoming & Family Weekend schedule for event access.

cards.title: Take the mud volleyball challenge
cards.subtitle: Spring tradition
cards.notes: Register or volunteer through the current Oozefest information when the spring mud-volleyball tournament is announced.
cards.short_summary: A long-running UB mud-volleyball gathering dating to 1984.
cards.evidence_claim: UB states that Oozefest began in 1984 with 16 teams and is a spring mud volleyball tournament involving students, alumni, staff and community members.
cards.source_title: Celebrating Traditions - Oozefest
cards.access_notes: Held each spring; registration, volunteering and sponsorship information is provided by UB when available.

cards.title: See International Fiesta performances
cards.subtitle: Student Association cultural showcase
cards.notes: Watch student clubs present rehearsed music and dance performances representing the cultures they choose to showcase.
cards.short_summary: A Student Association event centered on student-club cultural performances.
cards.evidence_claim: UB says International Fiesta is hosted by the Student Association and features student clubs rehearsing music and dance performances that showcase their cultures.
cards.source_title: Our UB Traditions
cards.access_notes: Consult the Student Association or UB events calendar for the current event schedule and attendance details.

cards.title: Mark the semester with Fall Fest
cards.subtitle: Student Association seasonal festival
cards.notes: Look for the Student Association’s Fall Fest listing and attend the scheduled music programming with friends or classmates.
cards.short_summary: One half of UB’s Student Association seasonal festival pair.
cards.evidence_claim: UB lists Fall Fest as a Student Association-hosted seasonal festival and says it features popular-music artists.
cards.source_title: Our UB Traditions
cards.access_notes: Check the Student Association and UB events calendar for current dates, venue and entry requirements.

cards.title: Welcome spring at Springfest
cards.subtitle: Student Association seasonal festival
cards.notes: Follow current Student Association announcements to catch the spring festival’s scheduled music programming on campus.
cards.short_summary: A spring counterpart to UB’s Fall Fest tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: UB lists Springfest among its Student Association-hosted seasonal festivals and says these festivals feature popular-music artists.
cards.source_title: Our UB Traditions
cards.access_notes: Check the Student Association and UB events calendar for current dates, venue and entry requirements.

cards.title: Catch UB on the Green
cards.subtitle: Summer concert series
cards.notes: Check the current summer lineup, then make time for a concert staged around UB’s green spaces.
cards.short_summary: UB’s summer concert-series tradition in campus green spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: UB identifies UB on the Green as its summer concert series and describes it as a way to enjoy campus green spaces.
cards.source_title: Our UB Traditions
cards.access_notes: Check UB’s current event listings for summer dates, location and attendance details.

cards.title: Explore the Latino Cultural Bazaar
cards.subtitle: UB cultural-bazaar tradition
cards.notes: Attend to encounter classmates’ food, customs and cultural presentations when the year’s bazaar is scheduled.
cards.short_summary: One of UB’s annually coordinated cultural-bazaar celebrations.
cards.evidence_claim: UB says it coordinates cultural bazaars throughout the year, including a Latino cultural bazaar, to showcase students’ foods, customs and traditions.
cards.source_title: Our UB Traditions
cards.access_notes: Check current cultural-bazaar announcements for the date, venue and participation details.

cards.title: Explore the LGBTQ+ Cultural Bazaar
cards.subtitle: UB cultural-bazaar tradition
cards.notes: Attend to learn from classmates’ food, customs and cultural presentations when the year’s bazaar is scheduled.
cards.short_summary: A UB cultural-bazaar celebration for LGBTQ+ students and the community.
cards.evidence_claim: UB says it coordinates cultural bazaars throughout the year, including an LGBTQ+ cultural bazaar, to showcase students’ foods, customs and traditions.
cards.source_title: Our UB Traditions
cards.access_notes: Check current cultural-bazaar announcements for the date, venue and participation details.

cards.title: Explore the Native American Cultural Bazaar
cards.subtitle: UB cultural-bazaar tradition
cards.notes: Attend to encounter classmates’ food, customs and cultural presentations when the year’s bazaar is scheduled.
cards.short_summary: A UB cultural-bazaar celebration highlighting Native American communities.
cards.evidence_claim: UB says it coordinates cultural bazaars throughout the year, including a Native American cultural bazaar, to showcase students’ foods, customs and traditions.
cards.source_title: Our UB Traditions
cards.access_notes: Check current cultural-bazaar announcements for the date, venue and participation details.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at University at Buffalo, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure first-weekend sequence that starts with wayfinding, moves through North Campus landmarks and ends with options for getting involved.

cards.title: Start with the Welcome Center
cards.subtitle: First floor, North Campus Student Union
cards.notes: Stop here first for directions and current event information, then use the building as your anchor while you learn the North Campus layout.
cards.short_summary: A practical first stop for campus directions and event information.
cards.evidence_claim: UB says the Welcome Center is on the first floor of the North Campus Student Union and staff provide event information and directions.
cards.source_title: Student Unions | University at Buffalo
cards.access_notes: The Student Union building is listed as open 24/7; office services have separate weekday hours.

cards.title: Settle in with a board game
cards.subtitle: North Campus Student Union
cards.notes: Bring a new classmate or roommate, choose a game from the Welcome Center checkout collection, and use the room for a simple shared break.
cards.short_summary: A free Student Union space for low-key social time.
cards.evidence_claim: UB describes the Board Game Room as a student space with games available for checkout through the Welcome Center, with free access for UB students.
cards.source_title: Student Unions | University at Buffalo
cards.access_notes: Free access is stated for UB students; game checkout is through the Welcome Center.

cards.title: Walk the edge of Lake LaSalle
cards.subtitle: North Campus recreational lake
cards.notes: Take a daylight loop by the water, pause to look for ducks or herons, and use the surrounding paths to orient yourself to campus landmarks.
cards.short_summary: A campus lake for an outdoor orientation walk.
cards.evidence_claim: UB identifies Lake LaSalle as a 60-acre man-made North Campus lake that attracts ducks, heron and geese.
cards.source_title: Baird Point/Lake LaSalle | University at Buffalo
cards.access_notes: Use daylight and follow posted campus guidance; the source describes fishing and sunbathing but does not state visitor fees.

cards.title: Find the columns at Baird Point
cards.subtitle: South shore of Lake LaSalle, North Campus
cards.notes: Use the outdoor amphitheater as a meeting landmark, look across Lake LaSalle, and save a photo from the columns before continuing your campus walk.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable lakeside amphitheater and campus landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: UB describes Baird Point as an outdoor Greek-style amphitheater on Lake LaSalle's southern shore and notes that it hosts bands for Springfest and Fallfest.
cards.source_title: Baird Point/Lake LaSalle | University at Buffalo
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark; check the campus events calendar for any scheduled use of the amphitheater.

cards.title: Make Lockwood your study waypoint
cards.subtitle: North Campus
cards.notes: Walk through the library, note the floors that fit your study style, and bookmark its research help before the first full week of classes.
cards.short_summary: UB's largest library, with collections and research support.
cards.evidence_claim: UB Libraries identifies Lockwood Memorial Library as the largest of UB's libraries and says it is located on North Campus.
cards.source_title: Lockwood Memorial Library | University at Buffalo Libraries
cards.access_notes: Consult the Libraries' current hours page before making a late visit.

cards.title: See Abbott Library on South Campus
cards.subtitle: South Campus
cards.notes: If you take the trip to South Campus, step inside Abbott to see its historic reading-room details and add it to your future quiet-study options.
cards.short_summary: A historic library stop on UB's South Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UB's visitor guide highlights Abbott Library for its handcarved mantelpiece, antique chandeliers and custom woodwork.
cards.source_title: Top 10 Places To See at UB | University at Buffalo
cards.access_notes: Check current library access and hours before traveling to South Campus.

cards.title: Check the Center for the Arts calendar
cards.subtitle: North Campus
cards.notes: Walk through the CFA lobby, look for current performance notices, and choose a future program that fits your schedule rather than planning around assumptions.
cards.short_summary: A North Campus venue for multidisciplinary arts programming.
cards.evidence_claim: UB describes the Center for the Arts as a multidisciplinary arts venue where performances take place.
cards.source_title: Top 10 Places To See at UB | University at Buffalo
cards.access_notes: Individual performances may require tickets or have separate entry rules; consult the specific event listing.

cards.title: Look for the current CFA Gallery exhibition
cards.subtitle: 201 Center for the Arts, North Campus
cards.notes: Pair your CFA visit with a gallery walk, then read the exhibition information on site to decide whether to return for a related program.
cards.short_summary: A university gallery with year-round exhibitions and educational programs.
cards.evidence_claim: UB says its two art galleries present year-round exhibitions and educational programs; it lists UB CFA Gallery at 201 Center for the Arts.
cards.source_title: UB Art Galleries | University at Buffalo
cards.access_notes: UB lists gallery hours as Tuesday–Saturday, 11 a.m.–5 p.m.; verify exhibition dates before visiting.

cards.title: Meet at the Bronze Bison
cards.subtitle: In front of the Center for the Arts, North Campus
cards.notes: Use this sculpture as an easy photo and meeting point before heading to the CFA, especially if your group is splitting up around North Campus.
cards.short_summary: A named campus sculpture outside the Center for the Arts.
cards.evidence_claim: UB's visitor guide identifies the Bronze Bison in front of the Center for the Arts and says it was modeled after an original at Buffalo's Central Terminal.
cards.source_title: Top 10 Places To See at UB | University at Buffalo
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark near the CFA.

cards.title: Locate Broadview Arena for future recreation
cards.subtitle: 175 Broadview Arena, North Campus
cards.notes: Walk over to identify the entrance and review available recreation options, then check the current schedule before returning for an activity or facility visit.
cards.short_summary: A centrally located North Campus recreation facility.
cards.evidence_claim: UB describes Broadview Arena as a North Campus multipurpose facility with courts, fitness areas, an indoor track and recreation spaces.
cards.source_title: Join Us | UB Recreation
cards.access_notes: Access and activity hours vary; UB directs visitors to current schedules and notes that some recreation access requires membership.
